title: Account
subtitle: Identity and Minecraft linking.
session_desc: The panel itself holds no credentials — every request rides your existing session cookie, whether issued by local password sign-in or the platform's identity proxy (Zero-Trust / Access).
linked_desc: Linked sessions can claim and own servers — ownership operations (claim, wake, stop) are unblocked.
step1_desc_suffix: in chat. The server already knows your verified identity, so it hands you a one-time code (valid about 10 minutes).
